summary: A configuration update in orders changed the inventory port to 8081, causing all downstream calls from orders to inventory to time out and resulting in widespread API failures across orders and gateway.

alerts.name: PodCrashLooping
alerts.summary: orders: container restarted 2.034 times in 10 minutes

hypotheses.summary: An incorrect configuration change set INVENTORY_URL to port 8081 instead of 8080, causing connection timeouts between orders and inventory.

evidence.quote: orders: call inventory through its new internal port (#227)
evidence.shows: A configuration change was deployed modifying orders.yaml
INVENTORY_URL was incorrectly updated to port 8081 while inventory service listens on port 8080

evidence.quote: POST /orders failed: inventory POST /inventory/reserve failed: could not connect to inventory (connect timed out)
evidence.shows: Orders fails to connect to inventory resulting in high error rates on orders and gateway

hypotheses.suggested_fix: Revert the INVENTORY_URL configuration in services/orders.yaml back to http://inventory:8080
